legal_claims_checked: Payment order: CPC 512,516,519,521; court may initially act without hearing debtor; 20-day objection after service to issuing court, whole/part, no reason required; proper timely objection removes corresponding order and converts creditor application to suit/mediation; no-objection enforcement and discretionary security-conditioned stay distinguished.

Promissory-note ruling: Negotiable Instruments Act 123 plus NCA 42–43; 10-day appeal after service to original court. No claim appeal alone decides substantive debt or automatically stays enforcement.

NCA 195: forgery/alteration special declaratory suit against holder, issuing court, within 20 days of service; proving qualifying filing requires stay, with holder/issuer security exceptions; other declaratory cases use discretionary security-conditioned stay.

Service: CPC 137/138 via NCA31, Civil Code120/122 and CPC161/162; substituted recipient and conflict restriction, deposit with required notice and ten-day effectiveness, start-day/holiday/travel-time qualifications. Reading the document or broker handover date is not automatically legal service.

LAF Filipino materials and current eligibility page actually opened; application and review, no guaranteed aid. Taiwan court procedure is separated from Philippine recruitment/loan-law advice.
